label: inframedial
definition: A positional quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being located between the midrib (costa) and the midpoint between midrib and margin of the structure that bears it, nearer the midrib than medial. NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991299 medial (sensu botany) and FLOPO:0991328 intramarginal; used of fern sori.
reason: A standard fern sorus position between costal and medial. FLOPO already has medial and intramarginal, but not this position.

Compressed fruits, seeds, spikelets and pseudobulbs are flattened. 'Slightly' is a degree modifier kept on the record, as for 'slightly glaucous'. The PATO synonym 'compressed' of condensed (PATO_0001485) is the wrong sense here.
A faint purple colouring: like 'purplish', it is RELATED to the botanical colour class purple FLOPO:0988008. 'Tinged' is a degree modifier.
A part, not a quality. PO_0030072 is the moss phyllid midrib (stereid bands, perichaetal bracts). A costa of a glume, utricle or fern pinna is the midvein of that organ.

label: apiculate
definition: A pointed quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's apex ending abruptly in a short, sharp but not rigid point (an apiculus). NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991054 mucronate, whose point is stiff; PATO has 'apiculate' only as a synonym of the attribute PATO:0000944 sharpness, so the value is lost. 'Apex' is the region context word.
reason: A common apex shape that at present only reaches the attribute 'sharpness'. Mucronate is close but means a stiff point.
Lepidote = scaly, as in the earlier rule C235. 'Sparsely' is a degree modifier kept on the record.

target: 00-part-and-quality.md: one row per value (spherical PATO_0001499; flattened PATO_0002254)
reason: A globose body flattened laterally, not oblate (that is depressed-globose, rule C170). Two existing values stated together.
An attribute heading for exserted vs included (FLOPO:0991121). 'Exserted to 7 mm' is a bounded measurement (pattern 02) of the exserted part.
A fruiting calyx that does not tear at the sinuses = not ruptured (PATO_0040044: components torn, for membranes).

target: new: measure of a named part without a class (wing part of seed or fruit)
reason: The length (PATO_0000122) of the wing of a seed or fruit. PO has no wing class, so the part of the bearer needs a pattern or an anatomy class, not a quality.
A part: stomata is an EXACT-type synonym of stomatal complex. Its sizes ('18 × 12 μm') and density are qualities of it.
A linear outline at the broad end of the range. 'Broad' is a degree modifier, and there is no other value to make a continuum.

target: new: measure of a named part without a class (claw of the petal)
reason: The width (PATO_0000921) of the petal claw. PO has no claw class (clawed is FLOPO:0991169), so this needs a pattern for the part of the bearer.
'Separated by 0–2 mm' is a distance (PATO_0000040) between neighbouring members of a series, a relation between parts. The qualitative form is distant/approximate (FLOPO:0991189/0991190).

target: new: measure of a named part without a class (sheath of stipule or leaf); leaf sheath PO_0020104 when the bearer is a leaf
reason: Length (PATO_0000122) of a sheath. For leaves the bearer is leaf sheath PO_0020104; stipular sheaths have no PO class.

target: new: measure of a named part without a class (claw of the petal)
reason: Same as 'claw width': the length (PATO_0000122) of the petal claw, a part with no PO class.
An attribute heading. Its values (erect PATO_0000622, buissonnant, terrestrial FLOPO:0991111) are grounded on their own, and the heading itself is no quality.

A comparison of length with another part: decreased length towards leaf (PO_0025034).
'Sympodial units plurifoliate' = several leaves per sympodial unit, an indefinite count of leaves.
A vein reaching the leaf margin is a relation of the vein to the margin (PO_0020128). The leaf-level equivalent is PATO_0001969 craspedodromous, which inheres in the leaf, not the vein.
A kind of inflorescence, not a quality: cincinnus and cincinni are synonyms of PO_0030132.

label: replicate
definition: A folded quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's margin or distal part being folded back upon itself. NOTE: Sibling of FLOPO:0991123 conduplicate and FLOPO:0991324 induplicate.
reason: A standard term for leaves, stipules and margins folded back on themselves. FLOPO keeps the other kinds of folding as classes under folded.
Bulbil is a synonym of aerial tuber. 'Rachis without proliferous bulbils' is its absence on the rachis (pattern 15).

label: herbaceous (sensu texture)
definition: A texture quality inhering in a bearer by virtue of the bearer's being soft, green and not woody, thicker than membranous but thinner than chartaceous. NOTE: PATO:0002352 herbaceous is a shedability (dying back to the rootstock), not this texture; 'thinly' is a second row, decreased thickness PATO_0000592.
reason: Floras rank blade texture as membranous - herbaceous - chartaceous - coriaceous. The herbaceous step is missing, and PATO's herbaceous means something else.
